symptoms: Small circular dark brown to black spots on older lower leaves
Characteristic concentric rings forming a 'target board' or bullseye pattern inside spots
Surrounding tissue turns chlorotic yellow; progressive leaf blight moves upwards causing extensive defoliation
Dark sunken leathery spots at stem end of green and ripe fruits
lookalikes: Septoria leaf spot (smaller spots with grey centres and black specks)
Late blight (water-soaked rapid rotting with white mould)
favourable_conditions: Warm temperatures (24-30°C) with intermittent rain, heavy dew, and high humidity (>80%)
season_or_growth_stage: Flowering to fruit development stage (40-90 DAT)
monitoring_and_confirmation: Inspect lowest foliage canopy for target-board concentric spots after rain or overhead irrigation
prevention: Stake indeterminate plants and remove lowest leaves up to 30 cm from ground (bottom pruning)
cultural_management: Crop rotation avoiding solanaceous crops (potato, brinjal, chilli) for 2 years
Drip irrigation to keep leaves dry
mechanical_management: Pluck and burn heavily infected lower leaves to arrest upward spread
biological_management: Seed treatment with Trichoderma viride @ 5 g/kg seed and nursery drenching

organic_options.treatment_name: Copper Oxychloride (Biological/Organic Allowed) or Bordeaux Mixture 1%
organic_options.timing: Preventive spray prior to rainfall or upon noticing first spot on bottom leaves
limitations: Purely protective; cannot cure existing internal mycelium in target lesions.

chemical_options.dilution: 30 to 35 g per 15-liter spray pump (500 g per acre in 200 L water)
chemical_options.timing: Preventive or early onset; repeat at 10-12 day intervals if humid weather continues
mixing_warnings: Do not mix with alkaline substances or copper fungicides.
chemical_options.safety_advisory: Verified against CIBRC label and ICAR/SAU package of practices. Follow standard PPE and PHI guidelines.

chemical_options.dilution: 15 ml per 15-liter spray pump (200 ml/acre in 200 L water)
chemical_options.timing: Curative and translaminar systemic control during active blight progression
mixing_warnings: Never exceed recommended dose. Observe strict 5-day PHI before fruit picking.
chemical_options.safety_advisory: Verified against CIBRC label and ICAR/SAU package of practices. Follow standard PPE and PHI guidelines.

resistance_management: Alternate contact multisite protectants (Mancozeb) with systemic QoI/DMI fungicides.
expert_referral_conditions: Contact local KVK agronomist or Kisan Call Centre (1800-180-1551) if infestation exceeds threshold.
